name: Pedro Demo Import
author: Mohammad Risad

sections.description:
A plugin to install demo content to themes developed by hmrisad.
This plugin requires the One Click Demo Import plugin to be installed.

Supported Themes

  1. Pedro

Notes

This plugin uses the TGM Plugin Activation library (https://tgmpluginactivation.com).
The library uses its own text domain (tgmpa) as per its internal design.
This is intentional and should not be flagged as a text domain mismatch.

sections.installation:
*** From your WordPress dashboard ***

  1. Visit ‘Plugins > Add New’.
  2. Search for ‘Pedro Demo Import’ and install the plugin.
  3. Activate ‘Pedro Demo Import’ from your Plugins page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with any WordPress theme?

No, This plugin will only work with themes developed by hmrisad.
